spans.s:
ग्रैव, अस्, ई, अम्, being on or belonging to the
neck, representing the neck, being on the neck;
(अम्), n. a necklace, a close necklace or collar; a
chain worn round the neck of an elephant.
ग्रैव ग्रैव. See under ग्रीवा last col.

ग्रैवेय, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the neck; (अस्,
अम्), m. n. a collar, a necklace; a chain on the neck
of an elephant or horse.

ग्रैवेयक, अस्, अम्, m. n. an ornament of the
neck, a chain worn round the neck of an elephant;
(आस्), m. pl. a class of deities (nine in number), who
have their seat on the neck of the Loka-puruṣa or
who form his necklace.
ग्रैव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to the neck.

ग्रैष्म, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the summer, be-
longing to the hot weather, produced by heat or the
hot season, sown in summer; (ई), f. Jasminum
Sambac.
ग्रैष्म ग्रैष्म. See under ग्रीष्म above.

ग्रैष्मक, अस्, इका, अम्, sown in summer; to
be paid in summer (as a debt).

ग्रैष्मिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to
summer, growing in summer.
